scope: Read-only application-source triage supplement; not a proof of universal non-reachability.
findings: Both Thymeleaf engines use ClassLoaderTemplateResolver with templates/ prefix and .html suffix; render calls use the fixed email/system and email/notification names. User-facing message values enter the context, not a dynamic template name.

No explicit ProcessBuilder, Runtime.getRuntime, gzwrite or GnuTLS invocation was found under src/main/java. The runtime image includes curl, and its Docker healthcheck uses a loopback HTTP health endpoint. Native/JVM/transitive uses are not ruled out by this source search.
followUp: Retain medium/low advisories and fixed-version maintenance candidates; rebuild/rescan the chosen hosting architecture before deployment. Escalate any refreshed high/critical finding to the coordinator.
